clauses.clause: Infected arrive from ≥ 3 street edges ≥ 60° apart and through wall breaches, staggered groups of 2–5 (not bulk); **none from tents/inside buildings**.

Every-tick newly appended emergedIds are grouped by the production same-tick/source transaction, not geometric clustering. Full admitted ID/position ledger retained; maximum5, minimum1. Both ordinary mortal complete final hashes equal current canonical receipts. The singleton counterexample closes FAIL; street-edge angular diversity, wall crossing and forbidden-interior clauses are not promoted to PASS.
